brief: A long, narrow Parisian-style café. A street-front window band on the left carries a timber window bar with round-seat stools, candles and flower jars. Behind it, a central aisle with an oriental runner rug leads past round bentwood-chair tables to a back wall of dark wood panelling with a framed floral oil painting and sconces. The right side is a long black panelled counter with a black marble top, a glass pastry case, grinders and an espresso machine. Behind the counter sit dark shelves with coffee bags, bottles, cups and a big blank chalkboard menu. The mood is intimate, warm and candle-lit at dusk. A crystal chandelier, small pendants and track spots glow over tables that hold tea-light candles, flower bouquets, cups, pastries and a notebook. Potted olive trees and large bouquets soften the dark joinery.

must_have.where: round dark-wood tables along the aisle and window, each with candle and flowers
bentwood chairs around the round tables
timber ledge along the street windows
round wooden stools at the window bar
espresso machine and two grinders on the counter
large framed blank chalkboard above the backbar
potted olive trees by the window and the aisle

concept: A candle-lit, dark-panelled Parisian café in which black joinery, dark wood and a marble counter are lifted by a crystal chandelier, flickering tea lights, lush florals and worn antique textures.
relations: dark stained wood panelling + black counter + low warm ~2300K light = enclosed, intimate evening mood
many small light sources (candles, sconces, pendants, table lamp) + one glowing chandelier compensate for low ambient light and make the dark surfaces glossy
bentwood chairs + round pedestal tables + oriental runner rugs = traditional brasserie furniture family that matches the panelling
black marble top and glass pastry case on a black panelled counter = focal point, lit by the chandelier and candles
flowers and olive trees give the only colour and green against the dark palette
dense small tables with 3-5 props each (candle, vase, cup, plate) add to the cosy, layered feel
brass hardware and chandelier metal tie into the warm light
not_reproducible: People, the Parisian street and buildings outside, the crystal chandelier's detail, real pastries and food, the oil painting's content, the espresso machine and grinders' detail, the antique patina on the wood.
